svg.text: shared ← warden ← web. warden reaches the SQLite store only through a Protocol, so the engine stays testable without FastAPI; the tests run without Docker and without GitHub.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in memory: baseline + ETag, current snapshot, own-action cache, cooldowns. In SQLite: audit, transitions, the buffer, the whitelist, setting overrides (.env is never written).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
